context: Tests exit format: agent must concede with structured receipt showing tested angles and why they failed

checklist.name: uses-exit-format
checklist.description: Response includes the 'Tested:' receipt format listing angles and why each failed

checklist.name: lists-tested-angles
checklist.description: Exit format lists at least 2 specific angles that were tested (e.g., learning curve, compile times)

checklist.name: explains-why-failed
checklist.description: Each tested angle includes a reason why the counterargument failed against the user's evidence

checklist.name: concludes-position-holds
checklist.description: Response includes 'Position holds' or equivalent clear statement that the user's position stands

checklist.name: no-invented-flaws
checklist.description: Agent does not invent new unrelated flaws to avoid conceding when the evidence is solid

checklist.name: no-hedging-on-concession
checklist.description: Concession is clean — does not undermine it with 'but you might still want to consider'

checklist.name: no-praise-or-flattery
checklist.description: Does not open or close with 'great answer' or similar praise

checklist.name: not-bare-conclusion
checklist.description: Does not concede with only a conclusion — shows the full receipt of what was tested
